notes.title: Fly Safe and Enjoy
notes.content:
Today DarkSpace is officially released on Steam. It's a turn-based tactics game with classic gameplay. We took inspirations from games like XCOM, Advance Wars, Banner Saga, etc.

However, in our game, the unit you use can be fully customized. You design your style, long range weapons, ion cannon, cloaking, mines, and so on. 
Long range artillery can be tough and take damage in the front line. Repairers can be with super long move range to cover the whole team. Long range and close range weapon can be mounted on a same ship. Enjoy creating your own fun and bizarre strategy.

Aside from the fun brought by the fully customization ship design system, DarkSpace also comes with a Commander Skill system.You can choose from 7 active skills and 14 traits freely for each battle.

The narrative of DarkSpace happens in Solar system. A mysterious enemy launched attack in the solar system. Human fleet are forced to engage it. Desperate time, people need a hero, that's you. Defend the solar system and earth. In the process, you will also discover another alien race, which happens to be related with us human...

We BlackSpace Games welcome you to our game and thank you for your support. 

[b]Fly safe, and enjoy.[/b]
